messages:
Ana Gomez: quick ask — our webinar signups are queuing on enrichment and SDRs miss the 1st-touch. need a QuickAssign flow for event leads.
Victor Chen: agree. propose QuickAssign=true on the registration webhook. HubSpot rule: if QuickAssign==true -> assign RR to 'webinar-quick' and set lead.meta.partial=true.
Priya Nair: technical constraints: enrichment sometimes comes in <1m but often 8-12m. plan: do immediate assign, enrichment must PATCH metadata only and never touch owner_id unless owner==null. add owner_ttl tag so ownership can expire if unaccepted.
Ben Holt: owner_ttl? curious — how will that work operationally?
Ana Gomez: owner_ttl=10m means if owner doesn't accept within 10m we auto-clear owner and escalate to overflow. prevents stale claims.
Victor Chen: implement as: webhook header x-rollout=canary for 5% initial. payload includes QuickAssign=true, campaign=web-q2, owner_ttl=600. HubSpot sequence: route -> set owner_preserve flag in SF upsert.
Priya Nair: SF connector update noted: upsert with preserve_owner=true and add custom field owner_ttl_seconds. We'll also emit event lead.owner_ttl_set.ms.
SDR-Bot: smoke test OK (200). sample payload: {"email":"attendee+qa@example.com","campaign":"web-q2","QuickAssign":"true","x-rollout":"canary","owner_ttl":"600"}
Ben Holt: SDR playbook bullets: 1) claim within TTL, 2) if profile.partial==true use Partial Script A, 3) if critical fields missing mark followup type "info-needed" and use backup-email. I'll paste scripts in #marketing.
Ana Gomez: edge cases: duplicates — if same email registers twice we should backfill into existing lead rather than create new and avoid reassign. HubSpot dedupe rule: match on email, merge, but if merged lead already has owner and owner_ttl_active, preserve owner.
Victor Chen: monitoring: create dashboard panels for accept_rate, median_accept_ms, owner_ttl_expiry_count, merged_duplicate_rate. Alert if accept_rate < 60% or owner_ttl_expiry_count spikes > 5% in 30m.
Priya Nair: canary rollout: start 5% at 09:00, watch 60m. If owner_flip_count > 2% or median_accept_ms > 600000 -> rollback. Also track 24h conversion delta vs baseline.
Ben Holt: post-event ops: run a 24h backfill job to reconcile partial profiles and surface which leads need enrichment backfill. We'll log backfill.run_id in the lead.
Ana Gomez: timeline: engineering to add webhook flag + preserve_owner changes today. Priya to update SF connector + tests. Ben to prep SDR playbook. Canary TOMORROW 09:00. :rocket:
